description:
21 modules were identified by `mix xref graph` as having no incoming references. After triage, 3 are intentional type/façade surfaces (no action needed) and 18 are fully implemented ports waiting to be integrated.

This epic tracks wiring all 18 into the live system. Children are ordered by dependency; agents must complete blockers before starting blocked tickets.

**Skipped (intentional):** `OctoPi.AI.Content`, `OctoPi.AI.Message`, `OctoPi.TUI` — pure type declarations or empty façades with no runtime code.
title: Wire all ported-but-unwired modules into the running system
